title: Data Engineer
description:
About the role
We are looking for a Data Engineer to build and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines on AWS.

Responsibilities
• Design, build and maintain data pipelines that ingest data from REST APIs and third-party feeds
• Develop serverless workflows using AWS Lambda and AWS Step Functions
• Model and optimize PostgreSQL databases and write complex SQL
• Implement incremental loads, data validation and data quality checks
• Troubleshoot production pipeline failures and improve reliability and monitoring

Requirements
• 2+ years of experience as a Data Engineer
• Strong Python and SQL skills
• Hands-on experience with AWS (Lambda, S3, Step Functions)
• Experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database

Nice to have
• Experience with Apache Airflow
• Familiarity with dbt
• Exposure to Amazon Redshift

Salary: PKR 250,000 - 350,000 per month

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Responsibilities
• Lead the design of our data platform on Spark and Kafka
• Own streaming pipelines and mentor junior engineers
• Build lakehouse on Databricks and Delta Lake

Requirements
• 6+ years of experience in data engineering
• Expert in Apache Spark (PySpark) and Apache Kafka
• Strong Python and SQL
• Experience with Databricks

Preferred
• AWS certification
• Experience with Kubernetes

title: Data Analyst
description:
Responsibilities
• Build Power BI dashboards and reports for business stakeholders
• Analyze sales data in Excel and SQL
• Present insights to management

Requirements
• 1+ years of experience in data analysis
• Proficiency in SQL, Excel and Power BI
• Strong communication skills

title: Data Engineer (Remote)
description:
This is a fully remote position open to candidates located in the United States only. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US; we are unable to sponsor visas.

Responsibilities
• Build ETL pipelines with Python, SQL and AWS Glue
• Maintain our Snowflake data warehouse

Requirements
• 3+ years of data engineering experience
• Python, SQL, AWS
• Snowflake experience

Nice to have
• dbt, Airflow

title: Remote Data Engineer - Pakistan
description:
We are hiring a remote Data Engineer. Candidates based in Pakistan are welcome to apply. Working hours overlap with UK time.

What you will do
• Build and maintain data pipelines in Python and SQL
• Integrate REST APIs and load data into PostgreSQL and Amazon Redshift
• Orchestrate workflows with Apache Airflow
• Ensure data quality and monitoring

Requirements
• 2-4 years of experience with data pipelines
• Python, SQL, PostgreSQL
• Experience with AWS

Nice to have
• Airflow
• Docker

title: ETL Developer
description:
Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain SSIS packages for data integration
• Write T-SQL stored procedures on Microsoft SQL Server
• Support data warehouse loads and troubleshoot ETL failures

Requirements
• 2+ years of ETL development experience
• SSIS and SQL Server
• Data warehousing concepts

Preferred
• Azure Data Factory
• Power BI

title: Data Scientist
description:
Responsibilities
• Build machine learning models with Python, scikit-learn and TensorFlow
• Run experiments and statistical analysis

Requirements
• 2+ years of experience in machine learning
• MS in Statistics or Computer Science
• Python, SQL

title: AWS Data Engineer
description:

• Build data pipelines using AWS Glue, Lambda and Step Functions

• Write Python and PySpark transformations
